_comment: Optional. Delete this file and everything still works with defaults.
'disabled' lists plugin names (the filename without .js) to skip at boot.
'config' is handed to each plugin as plugin.config.
_why_disabled: The bundled example plugins ship switched off.
httpserver would otherwise open port 3000 on a fresh install — a Discord
bot has no business taking a port nobody asked for, and 3000 collides with
half the dev tools in existence. hello would otherwise add a /hello command
to every server the bot is in.
webpanel is NOT disabled here, but it refuses to start without a credential,
so dropping it in does nothing until WEBPANEL_TOKEN_HASH or WEBPANEL_TOKEN
is set. It uploads and runs code inside the bot process; on a host that
injects PORT it binds 0.0.0.0 and that credential is all that guards it.
